title: Invertibility of the specified locally closed counit mate
statement: Fix the finite field datum D, a prime l distinct from D.p, a finite-dimensional field extension E of Padic l, n≥0 and A=O_E/(varpi_E^(n+1)) as in [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let S,T be separated finite-type D.k-schemes, and c:S→V closed, v:V→T open, with (c≫v)≫aT=aS. Assume the resulting Noetherian target and quasi-compact immersion instances. For any two ambient closed right adjoints a with their adjunctions [def-sf-locally-closed-comparison-coordinates], and any proof hb that J_et M is bounded below for every bounded constructible M [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], define gamma_M to be the F_proet⊣J_proet transpose of Delta_(J_et M)^(-1) followed by C_T(epsilon_et,M). Then gamma_M is invertible for every bounded constructible M. This statement asserts only invertibility of this constructed morphism, not existence of a full exceptional comparison or any relative Hom formula.

proof.text: Open restriction preserves bounded constructibility. Choose the quasi-compact complement of c in the Noetherian V and apply the closed comparison at v^*M. Use counit-compatible right-adjoint uniqueness to pass to the supplied adjoints. The chosen bounded-below lift identifies its named closed direct-image mate with Delta’s closed factor. Compose its invertible exceptional comparison with open restriction comparison. The closed counit identity, naturality of open extension comparison, and the normalized open counit equation yield the pasted counit equation for this composite. The pro-etale adjunction Hom bijection is injective; hence the composite equals the constructed counit mate. This identifies that mate with a composite of isomorphisms.

lean.statement: theorem locallyClosedCounitMate_isIso (D : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p) (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (n : ℕ) {S V T : Scheme.{u}} (aS : S ⟶ Spec (.of D.k)) (aT : T ⟶ Spec (.of D.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aS] [QuasiCompact aS] [IsSeparated aS] [LocallyOfFiniteType aT] [QuasiCompact aT] [IsSeparated aT] (c : S ⟶ V) (v : V ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion c] [IsOpenImmersion v] (hs : (c ≫ v) ≫ aT = aS) [IsNoetherian T] [QuasiCompact (c ≫ v)] : let A := Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1) letI : Finite A := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1) (by omega) ∀ (adjoints : LocallyClosedComparisonAdjoints A c) (hb : ∀ M : Etale.BoundedConstructibleDerivedCategory A T, _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus ((adjoints.etaleRight v).obj M.obj)), ∀ M : Etale.BoundedConstructibleDerivedCategory A T, IsIso ((locallyClosedCounitMate A c v adjoints hb).app M)
